cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful promotion. I trained you to write those reports, and now you get the director's office I applied for.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. You stopped sending me your drafts eventually. Beautiful timing, too, having one ready just when the director retired.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you just be happy for me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Delighted. Let me straighten your new nameplate; I taught you to check the spelling on official things. How lovely that they got yours right without asking me.

reason: Make the exact Drive operate through specific prior teaching and present correction. Keep a playable action at A5, with any new contest rule and penalty explicit, and preserve the partner actual contribution.
